title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Psalms 10: why Yahweh seems far off, the proud wicked man lying in wait, and the cry for God to arise.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask Yahweh at the start of the psalm?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:1 asks why Yahweh stands far off and hides himself in times of trouble.

answers.text: Why do you stand far off?
Who is like you among the gods?
How long will you be angry?

questions.text: In their arrogance, what do the wicked do to the weak?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:2 says that in arrogance the wicked hunt down the weak.

answers.text: They lend to them at interest
They drive them from the city

questions.text: What does the wicked man have no room for in his thoughts?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:4 says the wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

questions.text: What does the wicked man say in his heart in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:6 says he thinks, "I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble."

answers.text: "I fear the judges of the land."

questions.text: What is the wicked man's mouth full of?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:7 says his mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression.

questions.text: To what animal is the wicked compared as he lurks in his ambush?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:9 says he lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush.

questions.text: What does the wicked man say God has done, in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:11 says he thinks, "God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to lift up in verse 12?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:12 says, "Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don't forget the helpless."

questions.text: Whose arm does the psalmist ask God to break?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:15 asks God to break the arm of the wicked.

questions.text: What does verse 16 declare about Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Psalms 10:16 declares that Yahweh is King forever and ever.

answers.text: He rests on the seventh day
He is King forever and ever
